rejected_sources_or_transfer_rules.type: measurement-error cutoff in a recharge-estimability study
rejected_sources_or_transfer_rules.example: Xie et al. 2018 use soil-moisture measurement error as an added cutoff above calibrated-model RMSE.
rejected_sources_or_transfer_rules.reason: The rule is study-specific and calibration-relative, not an independent general application bound for scientific vertical-profile fidelity.
They lack a matched SCI-P purpose contract, depth support and profile/timing semantics.
Observation/product uncertainty does not automatically equal acceptable model structural error, especially across mismatched vertical support.
